subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, or should it be modeled through the existing reply-threading config surface?
rationale: The PR introduces a new config/default surface and re-enables an upstream-sensitive DM thread send path that was previously disabled, so code review cannot safely choose the permanent product API alone.

options.title: Decide API before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers choose the threading config shape, then require matching types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Accept separate dmThreadMode
options.body: Allow the new key as a deliberate Google Chat escape hatch, but require the complete config contract and redacted real DM proof before merge.

options.title: Route through replyToMode
options.body: Ask the branch to reuse or extend the existing reply-threading model instead of adding a parallel DM-only config key.

recommendation.title: Decide API before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers choose the threading config shape, then require matching types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and verified the prior DM-thread suppression behavior and is the strongest available routing signal for this product/API choice.
